title: Inside a Raging Sea Cannon Battle
hook: Flying wooden splinters killed far more men than cannonballs.

scenes.text: A broadside artillery battle between wooden sailing warships was one of the loudest, most suffocating experiences in military history.

scenes.voicedText: A broadside artillery battle between wooden sailing warships was one of the loudest, most suffocating experiences in military history.

scenes.text: In the cramped lower gun deck, gun crews of six men hauled 3,000-pound iron cannons back on ropes after each massive recoil.

scenes.text: Within three discharges, acrid black gunpowder smoke became so dense that gunners could not see their own hands or open gunports.

scenes.text: The deafening sonic roar ruptured eardrums permanently; sailors stuffed beeswax into their ears and fought with open mouths to equalize ear pressure.
